summary: Boolean state query: returns true if the object pointer at this+0xAF4 is non-null and its vfunc at vtable+8 (offset 0x8) returns non-zero, OR if the active slot index at this+0x864 is not -1. Returns false only when the object is null or ready AND the slot index is -1.

operations.description: Load the overlay/display object pointer v2 from this+0xAF4.
Indirect __thiscall through the object vtable at offset 0x8: (*(int (**)(int))*v2 + 8)(v2). Non-zero return indicates busy/active.
Guard on the active slot index at this+0x864: non -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) contributes true to the OR result.
